Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 94. Category: form. Pure Progress.

Power-Up
Your power grows to adapts to the enemy to the best of
your ability:
You gain +1 Power at the start of your turn, to a
maximum to half your proficiency bonus
Your unarmed damage die equals to the highest
unarmed/weapon damage die from a hostile creature
Your speed increases by 5 for every Power you
gained from any Form
At the end of your turns, you lost Stamina equal to
your Ki Rank
